skills.name: codebase-diagrams
skills.description: Create or update Mermaid architecture, user/data/API flows, sequence, database, deployment, and module diagrams grounded in repository evidence. Use for visual technical documentation of an existing system or selected workflow; not UI mockups, implementation planning, or a mandatory full-codebase knowledge bundle.

skills.name: design-psychology-rules
skills.description: Design, build, or critique user-facing interfaces using psychology-informed usability, accessibility, discoverability, and ethical-design checks. Use for screens, product flows, mockups, and pre-ship UX reviews; not unrelated backend changes or general code review.

skills.name: execute-plan
skills.description: Implement a selected ready task from an existing project plan, verify its acceptance criteria, and update task status with evidence. Use when asked to execute a plan task or take the next unblocked roadmap item; not planning-only requests, automatic whole-roadmap execution, or unrelated cleanup.

skills.name: feature-hardening
skills.description: Harden one selected feature with risk-based tests, failure-path investigation, and narrow verified bug fixes. Use for feature robustness, edge-case testing, and failure-handling requests; honors tests-only or audit-only scope. Not a general PR review, repository-wide rewrite, or automatic coverage expansion during ordinary implementation.

skills.name: implementation-planning
skills.description: Analyze a repository and create or update an implementation-ready plan for a feature, bug, refactor, migration, or technical requirement. Use when the user requests planning or roadmap maintenance before coding; preserves existing plan formats and task history. Does not implement tasks or automatically create saved roadmaps for inline planning requests.

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Review pull requests, branch comparisons, staged changes, or working-tree diffs for correctness, requirements, security, reliability, and production readiness. Use for pre-merge reviews, re-reviews after fixes, or “is this safe to ship?” requests. Produces evidence-backed findings and an approval, request-changes, or incomplete assessment; supports inline comments and host-structured findings. Reviews only, without applying fixes.

skills.name: production-cleanup
skills.description: Audit or remove confirmed unnecessary code, dependencies, demo artifacts, assets, and debugging leftovers while preserving intended behavior. Use for conservative repository cleanup and release cleanup requests; not ordinary code review, dependency upgrades, feature development, or a full security certification.
